versions.content: Mapping of IN and INOUT ArgumentDataPrototype s to callSignal s The ArgumentDataPrototype s that are passed to the operation (i.e. the direction is in) and the ArgumentDataPrototype s that are passed to and returned from the operation (i.e. the direction is inout) are expected to be mapped to the callSignal by the serializer.
